actions.diff:
--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -19,4 +19,5 @@
-    counts = {} if counts is None else counts
-    for pair in zip(ids, ids[1:]): # iterate consecutive elements
-        counts[pair] = counts.get(pair, 0) + 1
-    return counts
+    counts = {} if counts is None else counts
+    # C-level counting loop; inserts keys in first-occurrence order like the
+    # plain loop did, so ties in max()/min() resolve identically
+    _count_elements(counts, zip(ids, ids[1:]))
+    return counts

--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -32,11 +32,21 @@
-    newids = []
-    i = 0
-    while i < len(ids):
-        # if not at the very last position AND the pair matches, replace it
-        if ids[i] == pair[0] and i < len(ids) - 1 and ids[i+1] == pair[1]:
-            newids.append(idx)
-            i += 2
-        else:
-            newids.append(ids[i])
-            i += 1
-    return newids
+    a, b = pair
+    newids = []
+    extend = newids.extend
+    append = newids.append
+    find = ids.index
+    last = len(ids) - 1
+    i = 0
+    # jump between occurrences of the first element, copying runs in bulk
+    try:
+        while True:
+            j = find(a, i)
+            if j < last and ids[j + 1] == b:
+                extend(ids[i:j])
+                append(idx)
+                i = j + 2
+            else:
+                extend(ids[i:j + 1])
+                i = j + 1
+    except ValueError:
+        extend(ids[i:])
+    return newids

--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -8,2 +8,10 @@
-import unicodedata
-
+import unicodedata
+
+try:
+    from collections import _count_elements
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - pure-Python fallback
+    def _count_elements(mapping, iterable):
+        get = mapping.get
+        for elem in iterable:
+            mapping[elem] = get(elem, 0) + 1
+
